translated_title: China Backs Mexico Against Foreign Interference and Calls to Strengthen Cooperation During Roberto Velasco's Visit
original_title: China respalda a México ante injerencia extranjera y llama a fortalecer la cooperación durante visita de Roberto Velasco
author: Ángeles Cruz Martínez
meta_description: Receiving FM Roberto Velasco in Beijing, Wang Yi vowed China's support for Mexico's sovereignty and said their ties are “not directed at third parties.”
image_warnings: Featured is an illustrative CC portrait of Wang Yi (MSC/Kuhlmann, CC BY 3.0 DE) — La Jornada's original photo was Cloudflare-blocked.
